当应用需要进行音视频编解码处理时，请使用AVCodec Kit
适用于音视频播放器、视频通话、音频录制、视频录制等场景
当需要将PCM音频编码为AAC等压缩格式，或将AAC等格式解码为PCM数据时，请使用音频编解码能力
当需要将视频原始数据编码为H.264/H.265格式，或将视频码流解码为可显示的图像数据时，请使用视频编解码能力
当应用需要对媒体文件进行解封装（解析出音视频码流）或封装（将编码数据写入媒体文件）时，请使用媒体数据解析与封装能力
当需要实现HDR Vivid视频播放或录制、Audio Vivid音频处理时，请使用对应的高级编解码能力
实现本地视频文件转码为 H.264 或 H.265 / Transcode a local video file to H.264 or H.265
把 PCM 音频编码成 AAC 并写入媒体文件 / Encode PCM audio to AAC and write it into a media file
解码摄像头采集的视频帧并渲染到 Surface / Decode captured video frames and render them to a Surface
从 MP4 中解析出音视频轨道并分别处理 / Demux audio and video tracks from an MP4 for separate processing
将编码后的音频流和视频流复用生成 MP4 文件 / Mux encoded audio and video streams into an MP4 file
获取设备支持的音视频编码器能力和分辨率范围 / Query device-supported audio video codec capabilities and resolution ranges
配置码率帧率关键帧间隔以优化视频编码效果 / Configure bitrate frame rate and keyframe interval to optimize video encoding
实现低时延音视频编解码处理链路 / Build a low-latency audio and video encode decode pipeline
用 AVCodec 解码网络收到的 H.264 码流 / Decode H.264 bitstreams received from the network with AVCodec
接入 HDR Vivid 视频编码或解码能力 / Integrate HDR Vivid video encoding or decoding
实现 Audio Vivid 音频解码播放 / Implement Audio Vivid audio decoding and playback
使用 Surface 模式进行视频编码并输出压缩码流 / Encode video in Surface mode and output compressed bitstreams
preconditions: 工程可接入 AVCodec Kit 对应的 Native/C 接口并具备相关头文件与链接配置 / The project can access AVCodec Kit native C APIs and has the required headers and link configuration
输入媒体源可访问，文件描述符或流媒体 URL 有效且具有相应读写权限 / The input media source is reachable, and the file descriptor or streaming URL is valid with proper read/write access
所选音视频编解码格式、封装格式及高级特性已被当前设备能力支持 / The selected audio/video codec, container format, and advanced features are supported by the current device capabilities
inputs: 媒体文件描述符或流媒体URL / media file descriptor or streaming URL
音频PCM数据或压缩音频码流 / PCM audio data or compressed audio bitstream
视频原始帧、视频码流或Surface/NativeWindow对象 / raw video frames, video bitstream, or Surface/NativeWindow object
编解码与封装参数 / codec and muxer configuration parameters
outputs: 音频编码器输出的压缩音频码流缓冲区（如AAC等） / Compressed audio bitstream buffers output by the audio encoder, such as AAC
音频解码器输出的PCM音频数据缓冲区 / PCM audio data buffers output by the audio decoder
视频编码器输出的压缩视频码流缓冲区（如H.264/H.265等） / Compressed video bitstream buffers output by the video encoder, such as H.264/H.265
视频解码器输出的原始视频帧或Surface渲染图像 / Raw video frames or Surface-rendered images output by the video decoder
解封装器解析出的音频轨道、视频轨道、媒体样本数据和时间戳信息 / Audio tracks, video tracks, media samples, and timestamp information parsed by the demuxer
封装器生成的媒体文件或媒体容器数据（如MP4等） / Media files or container data generated by the muxer, such as MP4
编解码器能力查询结果（支持的MIME类型、分辨率、码率、帧率、Profile/Level等） / Codec capability query results, including supported MIME types, resolution, bitrate, frame rate, profiles and levels
HDR Vivid解码输出的视频帧或HDR Vivid转SDR后的视频帧 / Decoded HDR Vivid video frames or SDR video frames converted from HDR Vivid
Audio Vivid解封装得到的音频码流及元数据 / Audio bitstreams and metadata demuxed from Audio Vivid content
Audio Vivid解码输出的PCM或可播放音频数据 / PCM or playable audio data output by Audio Vivid decoding
可变帧率、时域可分层、ROI或B帧编码后的视频码流 / Video bitstreams encoded with variable frame rate, temporal scalability, ROI, or B-frame coding
编解码处理过程中的输出缓冲区属性（大小、偏移、时间戳、标志位等） / Output buffer attributes during codec processing, such as size, offset, timestamp, and flags

postconditions.statement: 代码中已创建并配置与任务匹配的音频/视频编解码器、解封装器或封装器流程 / The code creates and configures an audio/video codec, demuxer, or muxer flow appropriate to the task
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code to initialize and configure AVCodec-related native components (codec, demuxer, or muxer) that match the requested media task?

postconditions.statement: 媒体输入与输出通路已接通，包括文件描述符、URL、缓冲区或Surface回调处理 / Media input and output paths are wired up, including file descriptors, URLs, buffers, or Surface callback handling
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there a complete data path for media input/output such as setting source fd/URL, handling buffers, or connecting a Surface/callback?

postconditions.statement: 实现了启动、处理与释放资源的基本生命周期，避免只停留在声明层面 / A basic lifecycle for start/process/release is implemented rather than only adding declarations
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits show operational AVCodec usage with setup plus processing/start and cleanup/release steps, instead of only adding imports, stubs, or comments?
